title: Lovely Air Fried Dutch Lamb Tagine
description: A sour and shaggy Dutch dish made with lamb, cranberry juice, and air fried to perfection, served in a ceramic tagine, this meal is ayurvedic tamasic friendly and great for meal prep.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together cranberry juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Load the lamb pieces into the air fryer basket in a single layer, leaving some space between each piece.
Air fry the lamb for 20 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through.
While the lamb is cooking, heat a couple of tablespoons of oil in the ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the tagine and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Once the lamb is done air frying, add it to the tagine with the onion and stir to combine.
Simmer the tagine over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the lamb tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
